name: FortiVPN
author: Augusto Bauer Domingos
description: FortiGate SSL VPN indicator for the Omarchy bar, on top of openfortivpn. The icon appears while the tunnel is up and one click tears it down; connecting opens a floating terminal because the password and 2FA token have to be typed.

barWidget.description: Show the active FortiGate tunnel and disconnect with a click.

schema.label: Keep the icon visible while disconnected
